climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Côte de Nuits village in Burgundy making red Pinot Noir and white Chardonnay. Most of its vineyard land is the single Grand Cru Clos de Vougeot, about 123 acres and the largest Grand Cru of the Côte de Nuits. Village-level Vougeot is rare.
